lines.text: The enemies of Judah and Benjamin asked to help build, but Zerubbabel refused, since Cyrus had commanded them to build alone.
The people of the land tried to make Judah afraid to build and hired counselors against them until the reign of Nebuchadnezzar.
In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel and their associates wrote him a letter in Aramaic.
Rehum and Shimshai told the king that Jerusalem was rebellious and that, if rebuilt, he would have no dominion west of the Euphrates.
Artaxerxes ordered the men to stop, so Rehum and Shimshai went to Jerusalem and forcibly stopped the Jews, who were rebuilding the walls of Jericho.
